name: 小葵花鳳頭鸚鵡
illustrationTaxon: Cacatua sulphurea, representative yellow-crested bird; Hong Kong introduced population has uncertain subspecific origin

similarSpecies.distinction: 體形較大，亦具黃色羽冠；不能單靠有黃冠判定為小葵花，需結合大小、眼周和羽色。
展開的羽冠呈寬扇形且全白，不是黃色；僅作相似種比較，不代表香港常見。

featureNotes: 淡黃頰斑與深灰色鉤喙

rangeMap.caption: 原生分佈涉及國家概覽
rangeMap.disclaimer: 非全境；香港屬引入族群
rangeMap.note: Country-level native overview only. Native range is restricted to certain Wallacean islands of Indonesia and Timor-Leste, not all shaded territory; the map is not an occupied-island or occurrence polygon. Hong Kong and Singapore introduced populations are not shown as native. Citron-crested Cockatoo is treated as a separate species. Small islands may be absent at 1:110m.

sources.use: Yellow erectile crest, pale yellow cheek/undertail, introduced Hong Kong population, uncertain subspecies, native Indonesia/East Timor islands, IUCN CR.
Large Sulphur-crested Cockatoo comparison; yellow cheek wash can also occur, so cheek colour is not an absolute distinction.
White Cockatoo entire white umbrella crest comparison.

notes: Rarity is IUCN CR=5 of 7 stars, not Hong Kong abundance. The app importance index is separate from the rarity scale.
Text/scores/geography are programmatically typeset; AI pictures received basic visual review, not independent ornithologist verification.
